instruction: Two-Story Perimeter Window Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 2 building stories, 8 spaces and 8 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: L1 South-West, L1 South-East, L1 West-North, L1 Elbow, L2 South-West, L2 South-East, L2 West-North and L2 Elbow. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 52 total OS:Surface objects, split into 8 floor surfaces, 8 roof/ceiling surfaces and 36 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 4 Ground, 24 Outdoors and 24 Surface. Add 20 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 121.60 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 8 ideal-loads air systems, 8 zone HVAC equipment lists and 8 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 20.00 m in X, 18.00 m in Y and 6.40 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 400.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 486.40 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
